Sous-sol B, 18 h 40. Depuis le signaleme:
Basement B, 6:40 p.m. Since the report, Internal Review has had the lights in the aisles cut; only the desk lamp still runs off its socket.

Henrik KREMER hands you a flashlight without a word. Then: "Four places, Inspector. After that the guard does his round, and I will never have received your visit."
Les registres ouverts sur le bureau: The registers open on the desk
Deux registres côte à côte, ouverts à la:
Two registers side by side, open at the same page: the original travel register from file 40921, and the copy sent to your office. On the original, two lines. On the copy, three. The third is in fresher ink, in a more careful hand.

Your initials are at the bottom of the copy.
Les bordereaux de sortie des trois derni:
The withdrawal slips for the last three months, filed by date. Every original taken out bears two countersignatures: KREMER's, and a second one, in green ink, a single letter. "B."

Internal Review itself signed the withdrawals it denounces as "unrecorded".
Un carnet de permanence à couverture gri: A grey duty logbook. Every one of KREMER's night visits is noted in it, with the time and the office that asked: "check requested by Section 4", "by Section 7", "by Internal Review". They called him, he came down.
Le classeur métallique près de la fenêtr: The metal filing cabinet by the window
Tiroir du bas, étiqueté « 1971 ». Les ch:
Bottom drawer, labelled "1971". The folders are packed tight, except one, flat as a sheet: "VOSK, A. — Section 2". Empty. A stamp on the cover: "Withdrawn by order".

Behind you, KREMER says only: "Not now, Inspector."
Le haut du rayonnage, derrière l'échelle: The top of the shelving, behind the ladder
Il faut monter sur l'échelle. Tout en ha: You have to climb the ladder. At the very top, a box with no shelf mark: "Internal Review — B. — copies". Inside, copies of documents from closed files, corrected in green ink. Dates moved forward, lines added. The same corrections as the third line of 40921.
Le plan des travées, au mur: The aisle plan on the wall
The plan of basement B, annotated in pencil. A whole aisle is struck through in red: "H — HALVEK — reclassified 21.10". The box is gone. KREMER: "Reclassified means no one will find it. Not here."
Dans la poche intérieure, une photo plié:
In the inside pocket, a photo folded in four: two young inspectors on the steps of the Ministry, 1969. One of them is KREMER. On the back: "With A. — before."

KREMER takes it back from your hands. "That's mine." He says nothing more until the end.
Des mégots, un thermos vide, une tasse é: Cigarette ends, an empty thermos, a chipped cup. KREMER has smoked down here for twenty years. Nothing for the file.
KREMER éteint la lampe du bureau. Dans l: KREMER switches off the desk lamp. In the dark, his voice: "You've seen it now. You can never again say you didn't know."
